title: Kill Ratsputin
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Ratsputin in his lair off of Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 10 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Ratsputin in his lair off of Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

I want you to try your best to kill Ratsputin. Many have tried and all have failed. After a Dungeon Runner comes back saying that they were successful in slaying Ratsputin, lo and behold, there Ratsputin is with a broadsword sitcking out of his back but right as rain.

I trust you won't have the same problem, right? I mean, you've killed all kinds of stuff and it stayed dead, right? Is that a skill you have purchased off of a trainer? Maybe if you used all your skills at once he will die and stay dead... for once. At any rate, I want you to kill Ratsputin and kill him good. When you are done return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston for your reward.

Turn-in:

Your back! Is Ratsputin dead? Good. To be honest, I'd be ok with him just being dead for, like, thirty minutes. I would categorize that as a success at this point.... So, check back with me and I will know by then if Ratsputin is alive.

Objectives:

  • Kill Ratsputin

Level range: 75–100
